question: What ritual offering and principle must not be disparaged by the practitioner?
premises: The sacred offering caru must not be reviled.
The non-duality of the vow is affirmed.
The instruction is addressed to the fair one.
inference: One must not revile the caru offering and must uphold the non-duality of the vow.
plain_english: O fair one, one should not revile the caru offering, and indeed the non-duality of the vow.
